provenance.caveat: No way for the harness to start a Zed agent subagent has been verified.
No way for the harness to read a running Zed agent's state has been verified.
No way for the harness to message a running Zed agent has been verified.
No way for the harness to stop a running Zed agent has been verified.
No Zed agent event stream has been verified.

notes: Zed has no hook/PreToolUse lifecycle, so the harness cannot deny tool calls itself; policy enforcement is delegated to Zed's agent.tool_permissions prompts.
Zed does not implement MCP Elicitation, so decisions render as the canonical chat menu; there is no native question control to bind to.
Zed exposes no thread/session id to MCP servers, so host-session binding is unavailable (zed_adapter.zed_session_id returns empty).
